user.description:
A password can't be used here — Origin's login form is behind bot protection that blocks automated sign-ins.

1. Sign in at originenergy.com.au in your browser (with DevTools closed).
2. In the same tab, go to {jwks_url} — this just loads a page on the right domain so the cookie becomes visible.
3. Open DevTools → Application → Cookies → {cookie_origin}.
4. Copy the value of the `auth0` cookie (not `auth0_compat`) and paste it below.

Full instructions, including a fallback method, are in docs/session-cookie.md.

reauth_confirm.description: Your Origin Energy session has expired. Sign in again at originenergy.com.au and paste the new `auth0` cookie value for id.originenergy.com.au. Your existing energy history will be kept.

error.invalid_auth: That session cookie was rejected. Make sure you copied the `auth0` cookie for id.originenergy.com.au while signed in.
error.no_services: No electricity service found on this account
error.blocked: Origin's bot protection refused the request before it reached the login server. Your session cookie is probably fine. Try again in a few minutes; if it persists, please open an issue.

abort.already_configured: This Origin Energy account is already configured
abort.wrong_account: That sign-in is for a different Origin Energy account. Use the account this entry was set up with, or add a second entry for the other one.

init.title: Origin Energy options
init.description:
Origin publishes each day's usage in a single overnight batch, but the time it lands moves around by several hours. Polling more often than once a day means a late batch is still picked up the same day.

Each poll is a single request, and re-reading a day that was already imported is harmless — it just corrects it.

data_description.update_interval_hours: How often to check Origin for new usage data. Default is 4 hours; 24 restores the original once-a-day behaviour.
data_description.manual_statistic_id: The id of a statistic that already holds hand-entered readings for this meter, e.g. sensor.electricity_meter_total (see Developer tools > Statistics). Origin's hours up to that statistic's last value are skipped, so only later hours are added. It is only read, never changed. Leave blank to import everything.

error.invalid_statistic_id: That is not a statistic id. Use an entity id such as sensor.electricity_meter_total, or leave it blank.
